pinning_note: The base image linux_amd64_digest is the known-good digest reused from the previous monolithic image-lock.json. The rsync pin is documentation-only (pixi.toml exact-pins rsync). The pixi binary is pinned (version 0.80.0) and sha256-verified inside the Dockerfile; 'pixi install' resolves non-locked (no committed pixi.lock). The colabfold, openfold, bioir, and openfold_trt blocks from the old monolithic lock are not carried over — each kernel image has its own lock file.
